authoring_decisions.release_status: Approved course marks, posters and updated SCORM 1.2 ZIPs authorized on November 3, 2026. No live LMS upload or replacement authorized.

authoring_decisions.narration_delivery: New narration added to previously non-narrated Scrolling courses using maintained MP3 defaults. Original-video soundtracks preserved.
authoring_decisions.original_recordings: Dedicated media-only slides; original soundtracks, posters and existing captions preserved. Fixed slide Play is disabled.
authoring_decisions.animations: All ten existing teaching-video assets retained pending retiming to final revised narration; single pass with held final picture.
authoring_decisions.source_cleanup: Remove unrelated mindfulness boilerplate, broken spacing, repeated passages and decorative Rise framing. Current official program guidance supersedes contradictory recovered copy.
authoring_decisions.duration_basis: Final measured narration plus retained original recordings, with a modest allowance for reading and the final knowledge check. Optional close inspection of screenshot galleries may take longer.
content_corrections: OCP Accepted follows the current official FAQ: contribution alignment does not require disclosure of design files.
Volunteer selection follows the active operating policy and live notices; older election-calendar assumptions are not presented as permanent rules.
Procurement license families are described with use/distribution boundaries rather than blanket “contamination” claims.
Historical UI demos are preserved; task ownership, labels and exclusion-period timing must be checked in the active workflow.
authoring_decisions.media_qa: Previous media passed; revised narration-synchronized teaching videos require retiming and fresh quality checks.
authoring_decisions.audio_signal_qa: All narrated clips passed sustained-level, ending and artifact checks. Signal checks do not replace human listening approval.

module_structure.user_instruction: Revamp all five courses to one module each, with simpler nontechnical language and one final knowledge check.

authoring_decisions.figure_accent_style: User requested straight vertical side strips clipped to rounded card corners, applied to matching authored diagrams and animations.

animation_playback.review_instruction: Prefer videos timed to the audio narration; at the end of narration, stop with the final scene.
animation_playback.scope: All ten generated teaching videos; original recordings retain their own player and soundtrack.

previous_review_measurements.media_qa: Astra: all ten videos passed text containment, complete-pass playback, exact duration and native-browser encode-quality checks.
previous_review_measurements.audio_signal_qa: All narrated clips passed sustained-level, ending and artifact checks. Signal checks do not replace human listening approval.

module_structure.user_instruction: For now you can keep the two-module structure.

single_module_revision.user_direction: One module; simple, clear, elegant, evocative language; preserve substantive teaching and original videos; one recap and one final two-question check.

single_module_revision.original_video_policy: Original video and caption bytes preserved. User-authorized review narrates the three silent demonstrations using the normal synchronized video player.
single_module_revision.figure_policy: All existing asset files and paths retained. No authored graphic labels or geometry changed. Unused repetitive static figures remain available in source.

若选择让排除期届满，请让这项选填任务维持未完成。

slides.transcript: 适用协议包含三十天的排除期，是否豁免可以自行选择。每个参与组织的授权代表，都必须依要求通知基金会。豁免只改变等待条件，仍须取得委员会批准。若希望等待排除期届满，请让这项选填任务维持未完成，并与获授权的人确认决定。

slides.title: 步骤 15–16：确认并发布
slides.transcript: 发布需要委员会多数通过、贡献者确认，以及排除期届满，或所有必要组织完成有效豁免。请阅读决定；若要撤回，必须在发布前通过 Chat 通知基金会人员。这是最后一次确认。条件满足后，基金会人员会将批准成果发布到贡献数据库，并通知你。请检查公开项目，分享官方链接。豁免永远不能取代投票。

lms_catalog.title: OCP 贡献流程
lms_catalog.short_description: 跟随一份 OCP 规格，从摘要、审查、批准一路走到发布。
lms_catalog.overview: 贡献让有用的成果成为共享资源。通过贡献平台了解规格的提交流程，认识各阶段的负责人，并学习如何用清楚的文档与及时沟通推进审查。
lms_catalog.duration_note: 预估时间包含旁白、视频、阅读与最后的两题知识检核。若仔细查看流程截屏或探索延伸资源，可能需要更多时间。

modules.summary: 选择贡献类型、准备摘要、检阅《贡献者授权协议》，并使用正确范本。观看上传示范，了解项目与委员会审查、演示文稿及修订。认识排除期豁免选项、发布前所需的批准与确认，以及如何告知撤回或分享已发布的成果。
